description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Alons for Senate 712-389-7016 kevin@alonsforsenate.com Kevin Alons, an Iowa native, military pilot, and business owner, announced today that he is running for the Iowa Senate in District 7. The district includes most of Woodbury, all of Monona, and much of Cherokee and Plymou
